_comment: BIOS menu paths per board vendor and platform. xmp entries use the platforms intel, amd-am4, amd-am5; rebar entries use intel, amd or * (fallback when no platform entry exists). verified=true: the path matches the vendor's current BIOS manual or FAQ (ASUS FAQ 1042256 and 1046107, BIOS manuals E21631 and E25269; MSI Intel 700, AM5 and X570/B550 BIOS guides; Gigabyte Intel 700 and X670/B650 BIOS guides and Resizable BAR page; ASRock Z790 and AM5 BIOS setup guides and FAQ 498). Menu names still differ between board series and BIOS versions.

menus.path: Ai Tweaker > Ai Overclock Tuner > XMP I
Ai Tweaker > Ai Overclock Tuner > DOCP
Ai Tweaker > Ai Overclock Tuner > EXPO I
OC Tweaker > DRAM Configuration > Load XMP Setting
Advanced > PCI Subsystem Settings > Above 4G Decoding = Enabled, Re-Size BAR Support = Auto/Enabled; Boot > Launch CSM = Disabled (EZ Mode: ReSize BAR)
Settings > Advanced > PCIe/PCI Sub-system Settings > Above 4G memory/Crypto Currency mining = Enabled, Re-Size BAR Support = Enabled
Settings > IO Ports (Intel/AMD 400 and 500: Settings) > Above 4G Decoding = Enabled, Re-Size BAR Support = Auto/Enabled; Boot > CSM Support = Disabled
Advanced > Chipset Configuration > Above 4G Decoding = Enabled, C.A.M. (Clever Access Memory) = Enabled; Boot > CSM = Disabled
AM5: Advanced > PCI Configuration > Above 4G Decoding = Enabled, Re-Size BAR Support = Enabled

Intel: Advanced > Chipset Configuration > Above 4G Decoding = Enabled, C.A.M. = Enabled. AM5: Advanced > PCI Configuration > Above 4G Decoding = Enabled, Re-Size BAR Support = Enabled. Boot > CSM = Disabled
